sundaySharingNov25.firstDate: Finally we have the first date of the Sunday Sharing for this season. 🥞
sundaySharingNov25.winter: Winter has arrived and unfortunately Sunday jumping ends early. 🧊❄️🧤
sundaySharingNov25.purpose: That's why we thought of this event where you can meet up to fly in a group, train and above all have fun while waiting for the good season to return. 🪂
sundaySharingNov25.whatIncludes: What does the Sunday Sharing include?
sundaySharingNov25.mobilitySession: 🧘‍♀️ A 45-minute mobility session held by our coach Chiara Ferrero
sundaySharingNov25.flyingTime: 🦇 Minimum 30 minutes of flying in a 5+1 group suitable for your level
sundaySharingNov25.pizzaBeer: 🍺🍕 Pizza and beer at the end of the session
sundaySharingNov25.price: 💸 The price for the event is 140 euros per person.
sundaySharingNov25.registrationInfo: To register for the event you will need to fill out the form below, which will also help us understand which group is most suitable for you. Once completed, we will contact you to confirm your participation.
sundaySharingNov25.contactInfo: For any other information, please don't hesitate to contact us at the profiles indicated above.
